name: Randomiser
author: Lewis-Clayton
description: On a synth page, hold Shift and press drop to make a new variation of the current sound. The engine stays the same; its knobs, envelope, effect and LFO can change. Randomiser chooses from the effects and LFOs available on this OP-1. MIDI LFO is excluded. The RANDOMISER page in Settings picks which of them change, and whether the effect and LFO keep their type.
credits: Algorithm, history and panel by Lewis-Clayton / pcppcp; native kennel integration by Hundekraft
